# Ceylon Carriers Travels

Travel company in Colombo, Sri Lanka, founded in 1973. Two services:
1. Inbound: private tours of Sri Lanka for international visitors (destination management), with an English-speaking chauffeur guide, half-board hotels and airport transfers.
2. Outbound: escorted holiday packages abroad for Sri Lankan travellers, with flights, hotels, visa handling and transfers in one price where listed.
